short.lead: This builds the design you approved. Each tab's number counts only the cards the list is narrowed to (answer 1B, "Everything you narrowed by"). A picked project becomes the Board's heading, in its colour (answer 2A, "The heading names the project"). I will put it on the build branch for pull request #209 (the calm build), and your test link will show the change once I have pushed it there.
short.hint: Tap a step to see what it does.
items: Count only what the list shows (#217)

Each tab counts only the cards left after the Project menu, the Find box and Filter have narrowed the list. For example, with Home picked, the Up next tab counts only Home's tasks. With nothing narrowed, the numbers stay as they are now. New automatic tests cover three cases: a picked project, a word typed in Find, and a Show filter setting.
Name the project in the heading and hand it back (#218)

With a project picked, the heading becomes the project's name with a coloured dot and bar, and the Project menu gets a border in the same colour. A browser check confirms the heading, the border and the tab numbers. Then I rerun all the automatic checks, update the docs and the quality-check page, and move issues #216, #217 and #218 to 'needs review'.
